text:
tori: Ran into a weird edge in the sample app streaming resume flow. After an abort+resume the client occasionally receives a few stray bytes before the first `data:` line and then parts of two events glued together -> JSON error.
ben: can you paste the raw bytes you saw?
tori: sample log: ```recv: 0x02 0x10 0x7b 0x22 0x74 0x65 0x78 0x74  -> starts with 0x02 then '{\"text\"'
recv: data: {\"id\": \"r2\", \"text\": \"late\"}
recv: data: {\"id\": \"r1\", \"text\": \"first\"}
parser: combined => '\u0002{\"text\":...}{\"id\":\"r2\"...}{\"id\":\"r1\"...}' -> parse error```
qa-jill: reproable only behind the local dev proxy? or also hitting prod?
tori: only repro on devbox proxy (mitm). Direct to backend is clean. Happens ~3% of reconnects during bursty local dev traffic.
ben: interesting. Could be buffer reuse or backend writes racing when a connection is reused. Also check if auth refresh or a tiny health ping is happening at the same time.
tori: saw auth refresh bouncing shortly before some repros. Added a repro script that forces an auth refresh during reconnect. Steps in sample-app/streaming/REPRO.md.
infra-bot: filed INF-1011: "dev-proxy: investigate stray control bytes and write ordering on pooled connections".
ben: short-term SDK defense: don't assume chunk boundaries map to events. Collect incoming bytes and split on the SSE event separator ("\n\n"), and discard control bytes (<= 0x1f) at the start of a pending event if they precede `data:`. Emit a metric when the client trims leading control bytes.
qa-jill: will that hide a real bug in infra? Might make it harder to detect. We should log and keep the server-side issue open.
tori: agreed. I'll implement the defensive parsing in the SDK behind a feature flag and add telemetry that increments `sse.resume_strip_bytes` and `sse.resume_reorder_detected`.
ben: also add a small reorder buffer keyed by the optional `id`/`seq` field if present (buffer up to N=8 events or timeout 200ms) so we can tolerate brief reordering. Keep it disabled by default for now.
tori: local tests with a tiny node server that interleaves writes pass when the buffer+trim is enabled. Snippet in repro: ```js
res.write('\ndata: {"id":"r2","text":"late"}\n\n');
setTimeout(()=>res.write('data: {"id":"r1","text":"first"}\n\n'), 2);
```
infra-bot: INF-1011 updated: please attach tcpdump on next repro and try toggling keepalive/pooling options on the proxy instance.
ben: will follow up with eng-infra; in parallel I'll open an SDK PR with tests and the feature flag. Tagging @tori for review.
devex-bot: Created DEX-1320: "streaming: defensive resume parsing + optional reorder buffer; investigate dev-proxy pooled writes".
tori: thanks. Once infra provides pcap I'll attach it to DEX-1320. Short thread but actionable :thumbsup:
